text: A new report from the Urban Housing Coalition details the impact of rising rents in metropolitan areas. According to the data, median rents increased 14% year over year, outpacing wage growth by a factor of three. The report's authors describe the situation as a full-blown crisis that is ripping communities apart and condemning an entire generation to a future without hope or stability. Advocates say immediate legislative action is needed to prevent what they call a devastating collapse of the middle class that will scar our nation for decades to come.
